correctness.rationale: The explicit crown disconnected-triple condition is equivalent to \(B_n\) together with n isolated extra matched edges in the Alexander dual. Theorem 4.4 of arxiv:1412.0386 gives pure shellability of the 3-dimensional core for all \(n\ge5\). Face counting yields b_n, and adding matched 1-cells creates precisely n free \(H_1\) generators. Integral Alexander duality and UCT give exact torsion-free homology. Fixed-simplex signed Lefschetz sums, orientation-sign twisting, and the relative edge permutation establish both complete rational character formulas; exact finite checks n=5,6,7 agree for all cycle types and two prime fields.

value.rationale: An infinite natural graph family K_{n,n} minus a perfect matching has pure cut complexes with nonzero integral homology simultaneously two dimensions apart, forcing nonshellability for every \(n\ge5\). Explicit ranks and the full natural \(S_n\times C_2\) representation supply structural information not implied by Betti numbers or generic chessboard shellability alone; the \(n=4\) known case is excluded. Exact all-parameter symmetries and non-shellability are motivated topological properties, not an isolated arbitrary finite computation.
